WITH filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id, o.amount, d.A3
  FROM `order` o
  JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE o.amount > 2802
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    A3,
    AVG(amount) as group_avg
  FROM filtered_orders
  GROUP BY account_id, A3
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_average
  FROM group_averages
),
differences AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.account_id,
    ga.A3,
    ga.group_avg,
    ga.group_avg - oa.overall_average as difference
  FROM group_averages ga
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
)
SELECT 
  account_id,
  A3,
  group_avg,
  difference
FROM differences
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
